_about: One battle scene per operation. `accent` is the operation's ENCOUNTER color (G-83: enemies warm, the player cool): it marks the enemy side everywhere (the battle header count and rule, enemy card frames and name strips, the squad-select mission card, Help bestiary pages, enemy pop-ups, the result screen's operation and boss lines), one value per operation. `wall_texture`, `floor_texture`, `edge_accent` and `streak` feed the v3 perspective scene (debug F9 only). Colours are PixelUI token names, never hexes. Empty fields draw the bare scene. Operations without an entry use `fallback`. The dice tray floor (Kev, 2026-10-17, DECISIONS_RESOLVED G-84, replacing G-79's one reticle floor): each operation's scene entry names its own `tray_floors` entry as `tray_floor`; the root `tray_floor` (facility) is the floor of every scene without one (the tutorial and the bare fallback). There is no battle backdrop image (G-76): battle and in-run screens show the plain dark background token.

facility._about: One image at the tray's exact art size (260 x 223 art px = the 1040 x 892 design px tray / 4), copied as-is from assets/art_incoming/tray_facility.png (no conversion; tools/build_tray_floor.py --check verifies). battle_bay_floor.gd draws it one texel per art pixel, centred on the tray; a tray of another size crops the image's edges or extends it with the image's most common colour. A missing image leaves the plain dark background.
